deploymentGates: Explicitly review and apply the desired policy; this catalog performs no live writes.
Validate supported DNS syntax, reject HTML and error responses, and alert on unexpected count changes.
Retain a last-known-good snapshot on a failed update; implement verified rollback.
Use one base preset at a time. Do not enable optional parental or bypass restrictions for every device.
Keep upstream attribution and distribution notices. Review feed terms before bundling data or a commercial release.
Do not interpret fewer or more entries as a measured protection score. Test printing, updates, streaming, school and work services.
Gateway country policies and provider SafeSearch mappings are separate from domain-list selection.
